topic: Day 108 — reel — An apology that matters changes behavior, not just wording
text:
An apology
is [behavior].
The wording
is optional.
caption:
A beautifully phrased sorry followed by the same thing is just a more articulate repeat. Changed behavior is the only evidence.

Follow for one of these a day.
